prompt: Buying things on the internet such as book, air ticket and groceries is becoming more and more popular. Do the advantages of shopping in this way outweigh the disadvantages.
essay:
Purchasing goods through online marketplaces, such as books, airplane tickets and daily necessities, has grown significantly in popularity. This undoubtedly provides numerous benefits to the customers, but they need to be more selective and have cashless payment options. I believe the advantages for customers would be greater than the disadvantages of using online platforms to buy goods. This essay will examine both aspects in detail.

On the one hand, buying products through online marketplaces is really effective and minimizes time consumption for customers, who only need to hold their smartphones or laptops then open digital platforms such as Amazon, Alibaba and Carousell. This allows customers to save commuting time, avoid traffic congestion on the roads and shop more cost-effectively compared to visiting physical stores. In addition, people are able to compare prices, specifications and delivery times prior to checking out their shopping carts, which helps them to secure the best deal. For example, if customers buy a shirt, they can compare the price and delivery time across different vendors. They are able to choose the cheapest one, while it has the longest delivery time, as long as it is suitable for their preferences.

On the other hand, consumers are also exposed to negative risks of the product quality. They cannot visually check the condition of the products prior to delivery, which quite often leads to a dispute with the sellers. If such a case occurs, consumers need more time to return the items and wait for the replacement. Furthermore, most payment methods are only available digitally or via cashless systems. Customers must have credit cards or other digital wallets to support transactions, which would be challenging for people from rural areas.

In conclusion, I believe the benefits of online digital platforms will be far greater than their drawbacks. People can save more time, and they have more alternative stores to compare with. However, people also need to be mindful of the product quality and the availability of payment methods.
